question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**introversion**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The context indicates that Federico's academic experience of isolation was partly due to his own personal tendency.
 
• 'Introversion' means a tendency to direct one's interest towards one's own thoughts and feelings rather than towards the external world, which fits the context of his isolation.
 
• Other options like 'molestation', 'quantification', and 'interrogation' do not fit the context of describing a personal tendency that would lead to isolation.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: * The mathematician Federico Ardila-Mantilla grew up in Colombia, an **indifferent**__ student but gifted in math. He was failing most of his classes at his high school in Bogotá when someone __**suggested**__ him to apply to MIT. He had not heard of the school. To his surprise, he got in, and he went on scholarship. Mathematically, he did well. One of his professors, an acid-tongued theoretician known to __**compare**__ his audience to a herd of cows, routinely tucked 'open' math problems into homework assignments, without telling the students. These had never been solved by anyone. Ardila solved one. He went on to receive his bachelor's and Ph.D. in math from MIT. But his academic experience was also one of isolation. Part of it had to do with his own __**introversion**__. Part of it was cultural. As a Latino, he was very much in the minority in the department, and he did not feel comfortable in American mathematical spaces. No one had tried to explicitly __**exclude**__ him, yet he felt alone. In math, collaborating with others opens up new kinds of learning and thinking. But in his nine years at MIT, Ardila worked with others only twice. * 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Molestation (छेड़खानी): 'Molestation' means the action of pestering or harassing someone, typically in an aggressive or persistent manner, which does not fit the context.
 
• Quantification (मात्रांकन): 'Quantification' means the expression or measurement of the quantity of something, which is unrelated to expressing a personal tendency.
 
• Interrogation (पूछताछ): 'Interrogation' means the action of interrogating or questioning someone, which does not fit the context of describing a personal tendency.
